execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a cut commits only when its round completes. The trial record persists; exposure continues unattended without charge until stop, removal, spoilage or death.

details.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. prepare: inputStackId, your own unspoiled uncut root or berry stack with 1 + controlQuantity whole units (one unit per trial); toolId, your own carried whole stone or flint unit whose edge passes the world contact model (radius at most 0.0002, hardness 8+, not fractured or contaminated); a layer area of 5 x unit mass: a ground footprint centred at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius, or supportId, a food surface in reach at least that large. One round, 1.5 energy. inspect: in reach of the slices or carrying them; one round, 0.2 energy. resume: re-lays slices you picked up, same placement rules, no cutting; one round, 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate. instrumentId is refused: no calibrated balance exists.
details.effects: Cutting keeps the unit's mass, water, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; no offcut is represented; the edge gains no wear. Slices lie unowned as one sample with the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85; opening damage 1.1). Each round: water moves toward an equilibrium fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (0.1-0.35) by at most 0.025 x area x (temperature - 5)/20 (0-2), so no gradient or warmth, no drying; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; decay is the ordinary rate x 1.1 x (0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction/initial) (0.15-1.5), never reset. The control ages normally while carried. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay of slices and control and their difference, visible shrinkage and wetness, and rain rounds as an unverified record; shrinkage does not measure water; spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety stay unverified. Anyone may take lying food: you taking the slices pauses the trial until resume; others taking them, spoilage, stop or death end it and release the control once. No refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a look commits only when its round completes. No work, escrow or process persists.

details.costs: Study: 3 rounds, 0.5 energy each. select: sourceId, a loose non-food material source within reach; one round, 0.2 energy; nothing is gathered (gather costs 2 energy per unit). inspect: inputStackId, your own carried unreserved non-food item of at least one whole unit; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. shape and any instrumentIds are refused. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate.
details.effects: Reports, as an unverified personal record, the material, whole units and the world contact model hardness index, edge radius (0.001 / index when unworn), wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact, each marked observed, model value or failed against the rule thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1 applies, and whether all are met. Under this model every intact, unworn whole stone (index 8, radius 0.000125) or flint unit (9, 0.000111) meets it; each scratch stroke that wears a piece adds 0.00001 to its radius. Loose source units are not individually represented, so select reports what one gathered unit would show. Nothing is gathered, shaped, measured by an instrument or changed; no tool, equipment or food safety is created. Shaping is refused: the world has no fracture, flaking or sharpening law and abrasion only blunts. The drying trial still runs its own check and must be learned separately. No refund or reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
